chunks.text: Comfyrizz turns one package into a finished launch video.

chunks.text: Everything you see is generated from code.

Generated-first assets start as S V G.

chunks.text: Each vector is sanitized and render-checked on the CPU before it reaches the composition.
chunks.spoken: Each vector is sanitized and render-checked on the C P U before it reaches the composition.

chunks.text: This launch video renders locally in about eighty seconds.
